anomalies.description: Large crowd of protesters clashing with riot police in front of a building; officers in helmets and shields are engaged in physical confrontation with demonstrators, some raising hands or objects, indicating collective violent unrest.
Large crowd of civilians clashing with riot police in helmets and shields; visible pushing, shoving, and use of batons by police; smoke or tear gas present.

Continued violent unrest: chaotic movement, falling individuals, obscured view due to rapid camera motion and proximity to conflict; smoke still visible; crowd and police remain engaged in physical confrontation.; Large, dense crowd engaged in chaotic movement with visible smoke/dust in the air; individuals appear to be clashing or pushing against a line of uniformed personnel (likely security forces) behind barriers; repeated frames show surging motion, raised arms, and apparent confrontation consistent with violent unrest.

A large group of people is seen in a state of chaotic movement, with visible smoke or tear gas (f0), individuals covering faces (f1, f4), and collective running/retreating behavior across multiple frames (f3–f15). The scene shows signs of violent unrest: people are fleeing, some appear to be assisting others, and the environment includes dispersal agents and disorganized motion consistent with a riot or crowd control response.

In frames f3–f8, multiple individuals are engaged in close physical contact that appears mutual and aggressive: one man in a brown coat is seen grappling with another (f3, f4), and later (f7–f8) two men are seen grabbing and pulling each other’s clothing in a manner consistent with hand-to-hand combat, not mere assistance or crowd jostling.

A large crowd engages in violent unrest; multiple individuals carry and wield a metal frame (likely a barricade or stretcher) as a weapon, pushing through the crowd while others flee or confront them. The scene shows chaotic movement, physical clashes, and collective aggression.

Sustained violent group clash involving civilians and uniformed personnel in riot gear (helmets, batons); escalation includes use of barriers as weapons, pursuit, and dispersal tactics across the street.
Multiple individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat, including grappling and striking, around a fallen metal barrier; one person in red is actively involved in the scuffle.

A person in red appears to be pinned or held down by multiple individuals while being struck; the victim is on the ground or low to the ground and unable to effectively resist, suggesting targeted assault on a helpless individual amid the chaos.

Riot police in helmets and dark uniforms enter the scene from left, advancing with batons drawn and engaging protesters; civilians scatter, some running away, others confronting officers—indicating escalation of collective violent unrest.
A person in dark clothing appears to be on the ground or falling while multiple riot officers converge and strike downward with batons, suggesting targeted assault on a vulnerable individual.
Large-scale unrest visible in wider street view: dense crowd, vehicles (including armored van), smoke/dust, and chaotic movement indicating ongoing riot conditions.

Large crowd of people in a street setting with armored vehicle present; individuals are moving rapidly, some running away, others gathered on overpass; smoke appears later (from ~104.5s), indicating use of crowd-control agents or similar during unrest.

A person in tactical gear on top of an armored vehicle is holding a rifle in a firing posture, with visible muzzle flash and smoke at the barrel in frame f1 (104.5s), indicating discharge.; At frame f9 (104.5s), a large plume of white smoke erupts near the crowd directly in front of the armored vehicle’s turret, consistent with discharge of a projectile (e.g., tear gas canister or less-lethal round) from the weapon mounted on the vehicle. The shooter remains aimed and stationary before/after. No muzzle flash visible due to low resolution, but timing and smoke location strongly suggest firing event.; Second smoke burst observed at f10 (105.0s) and persisting into f11 (105.5s), again originating near the crowd in front of the vehicle’s weapon. Suggests repeated discharge of crowd-control munitions from the same position.

Sustained violent unrest: armored vehicles deploy tear gas/smoke against crowds; civilians flee, gather on overpass, and confront security forces; multiple smoke plumes and chaotic movement indicate collective violent clash.

Large crowds are gathered on the pedestrian overpass and street-level sidewalks; individuals are seen running away from the armored vehicle after it fires, consistent with violent unrest or dispersal under force.
A visible muzzle flash and smoke plume erupt from the weapon mounted on the armored vehicle at the intersection, indicating a discharge of the firearm.

A large group of people are engaged in chaotic movement across a street intersection; individuals are seen throwing objects, raising arms aggressively, and running in disorganized patterns, consistent with a violent unrest or clash.; A large group of people are engaged in violent unrest on a street, with individuals throwing objects, running, and confronting each other; a vehicle (likely a bus or armored vehicle) deploys a large cloud of white smoke (tear gas or similar crowd-control agent) at 145.5s onward, causing dispersal and chaos.

A large cloud of white smoke (consistent with tear gas or smoke grenades) erupts near a vehicle under an overpass; crowd members scatter, raise hands, and flee while others confront the source—indicating active suppression of a riot.; A large crowd of people is seen moving rapidly and chaotically under an overpass, with some individuals raising arms and apparent smoke or dust in the background; this suggests collective violent unrest or confrontation rather than a peaceful gathering.

A sudden, large-volume white smoke plume erupts from near a vehicle under the overpass, consistent with a canister discharge (e.g., tear gas grenade), producing an explosive-like rapid expansion and dispersion. The onset is abrupt and localized, not a sustained fire or slow release.

A sudden burst of white smoke/dust erupts near a bus under an overpass in frame f0, consistent with a small-scale explosion or detonation (not sustained fire). The plume expands rapidly in subsequent frames.

After the initial smoke deployment, the scene shifts to a multi-story building emitting thick white smoke from upper-floor windows, suggesting fire or secondary incendiary device activation during ongoing unrest; crowd remains agitated nearby.

Crowd movement continues intensely near the burning building; people are running and clustered densely, with visible agitation and directionality suggesting ongoing unrest concurrent with the fire/smoke event.
